name: Creality Falcon 5W
tagline: Creality’s compact Falcon 5W: small-bed entry engraver
tldr: Creality Falcon 5W is the small CR-Laser Falcon for desktop engraving and light crafts: lower power than Falcon 10W/A1 but simpler footprint and price.
mainObjective: Creality-branded entry engraver for small projects

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: 5W on Creality Falcon: engraving-first: photo fills and leather at moderate speeds
Open-frame: plan laser glasses, exhaust, and workspace rules from day one
Software on the profile: trial your workflow on scrap before production
cons: Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone
Confirm optical wattage on the listing before you buy
beginnerNotes: This profile covers Creality Falcon 5W. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks before buying, then compare nearby models on the Compare page.
proTips: Run scrap tests first. Use this profile’s reference times for quotes, not marketing claims.

editorialDepth.advantages: Creality Falcon 5W suits makers who sell marks, photos, and gifts more than daily panel cutting. Reasonable open-frame entry price.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you already quote 4 mm+ cutting in production. Not for cast acrylic or bare metal without spray.
